heard_on_the_hill.headline: Moolenaar asks Pentagon to blacklist Chinese universities
heard_on_the_hill.body: House Select Committee on the CCP Chairman John Moolenaar called on the Pentagon to update its list of PLA-linked institutions and foreign talent-recruitment programs. In a letter to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, he urged designation of 58 Chinese universities and 62 technology labs as national security threats, SCMP reported, and Beijing called the request Cold War-style overreach.

heard_on_the_hill.headline: CECC releases Ian Urbina testimony on China
heard_on_the_hill.body: The Congressional-Executive Commission on China released testimony by Ian Urbina titled "The Outlaw Ocean Project Investigation: China" on October 16.

heard_on_the_hill.headline: ASML says proposed U.S. chip-tool curbs would backfire
heard_on_the_hill.body: ASML's chief financial officer said proposed U.S. legislation, the Match Act, restricting the Dutch firm's sales of deep ultraviolet lithography equipment to China would be "counterproductive," Reuters reported.

research.line: Covers the Trump administration's new diesel deal with Russia, a Europe-China agreement limiting Chinese hybrid vehicle exports, and a court ruling on tariff refunds.
